----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Shri S. P. Deshpande, Addl. P.P. for non-applicant No.1-State.
 Coram: Z.A. Haq & Amit B. Borkar, Jj.
Dated : 16/02/2021.
1.

The criminal application is filed on 25/02/2020 praying that the First Information Report
registered against the applicant for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 of
the Indian Penal Code and Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 be quashed.

2. The matter was listed before the Court on 18/12/2020 on which date Advocate for the applicant
was absent.
3.  This Court directed issuance of notice to the non-applicants.
Today, the matter is listed with the office note that the applicant has not supplied the copy of criminal application, hence, notice could not be issued.
4. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the non-applicant No.1 submitted that the charge sheet is filed on 09/03/2020.
Today also, none present for the applicant.
It appears that the applicant is not interested in prosecuting the criminal application.
